reddit.title: Introducing Material Management for Building in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to announce a significant update to how you manage building materials in Provincia! Instead of a confusing single cost chip, each paid build entry now features a clear **Materials** control. This allows you to see exactly what resources you have versus what you need, with any shortages highlighted for easy reference. You can now keep track of your building requirements without the guesswork. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Enhanced Material Management in Provincia
steam.body: We're excited to unveil a new feature that streamlines how you manage building materials in Provincia. The **Materials** control replaces the old single cost chip, providing a comprehensive overview of what you have versus what you need for each build. This update aims to enhance your planning and efficiency. For more details, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
